artDirection.backgroundPrompt:
A bold 3D isometric AK-47 featuring CB's signature purple (#8D52DA) as the dominant body color with vibrant orange (#FF6B2F) Asimov geometric patterns and bright white accent highlights. The rifle is positioned at a dynamic 25-degree tilt with slight perspective rotation to create visual impact while maintaining recognizability. The geometric Asimov skin pattern consists of angular white and orange segments that create a futuristic overlay across the barrel, stock, and receiver areas. The 3D form uses premium matte rendering with soft gradient fills and consistent top-left lighting that creates dimensional depth through subtle shadows on the right and bottom edges. Clean beveled surfaces and smooth polygon geometry maintain the high-quality game-asset appearance. The geometric pattern overlay features sharp triangular and polygonal shapes that appear embossed into the weapon surface, creating additional visual interest. Purple-to-lighter-purple gradient fills add sophisticated depth while orange pattern segments provide striking contrast. Soft drop shadow with minimal opacity offset grounds the icon professionally.

Follow vault-pictograms-others' purple gradient 3D approach for the rifle body, incorporating vault-pictograms-competitions-1's orange accent treatment for the geometric Asimov pattern segments
